trimmingSuggestions.description: The information about the full mod being in development is repetitive.
Showing the Mega download is redundant.
The WinRAR installation process is straightforward and can be trimmed.
The Mod Manager installation tutorial is already linked.
Choosing one method (drag and drop or import) for mod installation would be sufficient.
